jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Type:**

Permanent

**Build a brilliant future with Hiscox**

**The role**

We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic professional who will be a key and influential member of our Hiscox London Market Engineering Team, within the Software Engineering Chapter. In this role you will be working in one of our various squads as we create new “Cloud First” solutions to add value to the business, while supporting and transforming our existing on-prem and cloud systems. We are looking for someone who is aligned with modern software engineering practices and ready to embrace the use of AI enabled development tool and adapt to the ever changing space as we enter the agentic SDLC phase to allow rapid delivery of high quality value.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Work collaboratively with your squad and stakeholders to contribute to delivering business outcomes
* Write clean, maintainable code following best practices such as SOLID principles, design patterns, unit testing, peer review, and CI/CD processes
* Ensure documentation are up to date and detailed comments added to the stories
* Support team members by learning from others and sharing knowledge as you grow in your role
* Assist in designing solutions and implementing changes based on requirements
* Collaborate with engineers across teams to learn about and contribute to our architecture
* Ensure your work follows security and engineering standards with support from the team
* Be open to learning and adopting new ways of working, including AI-assisted development tools and ever changing space as we enter agentic SDLC phase
* Work collaboratively with team members located in the United Kingdom, Portugal, Poland, and India to deliver value

**Skills**:

* Academic degree in a closely related field (or 3+ years employment in a Software Engineering role)
* Candidates should have a strong foundation and hands-on experience in C# and .NET, with the ability to write and maintain effective unit tests.
* Should have a solid background in SQL and be comfortable working with relational databases
* Should have knowledge on CI/CD pipelines and a good understanding of source control systems and branching strategies
* Exposure to Azure technologies such as Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, and Azure API Management (APIM) would be considered an advantage
* Knowledge on Azure Service Bus would be advantageous, particularly in event-driven or messaging-based architectures.
* Familiarity with modern front-end technologies such as Blazor/Angular/React would be beneficial for building responsive and user-friendly applications.

### **Behaviours**

* Demonstrates enthusiasm for learning new technologies, tools, and ways of working, actively seeking opportunities to grow technical and professional skills.
* Takes ownership of assigned tasks and delivers work to agreed standards with appropriate support and guidance.
* Communicates clearly and respectfully with colleagues, asking thoughtful questions and sharing progress proactively.
* Collaborates effectively with teammates and contributes positively to an inclusive and supportive team environment.
* Shows curiosity about the business, customers, and products, seeking to understand how their work contributes to business outcomes.
* Follows established engineering standards, development practices, and security requirements, while building a strong foundation in software engineering principles.
* Approaches challenges with a positive mindset, demonstrating resilience and a willingness to learn from mistakes and feedback.
* Adapts to changing priorities and embraces new ways of working in a fast-paced environment.
* Seeks and acts upon feedback to continuously improve technical skills, effectiveness, and professional development.
* Demonstrates attention to detail and a commitment to producing reliable, well-tested, and maintainable solutions.
* Contributes ideas and suggestions for improving processes, team practices, and customer outcomes.
* Builds positive working relationships through professionalism, respect, empathy, and a willingness to support others.
* Takes responsibility for personal learning and development and actively participates in knowledge-sharing opportunities.
* Demonstrates a growth mindset, showing initiative and motivation to broaden technical expertise and industry knowledge.

**Diversity and flexible working at Hiscox:**

At Hiscox we care about our people. We hire the best people for the job and we’re committed to diversity and creating a truly inclusive culture, which we believe drives success.

We have also learned over the past couple of years that working life doesn’t always have to be in the office, and have adopted hybrid ways of working to encourage a healthy work life balance.

We see it as the best of both worlds: structure and sociability on one hand, and independence and flexibility on the other.

If you don’t meet every requirement but are excited about the role, we’d still love to hear from you.

*Work with amazing people and be part of a unique culture*

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer WPF/MAUI
jobs.description:
Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4.com.

**What you will do. A glimpse into your role:**

As a **Senior .NET Developer** is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting **.NET WPF/MAUI applications** and **.NET web services**. This role contributes to delivering high-quality solutions that meet business requirements and align with technology standards. The position plays a key role in technical reviews, architecture improvements, and implementing best practices within an Agile team environment.

**Every action has an impact. You will make a difference here if you:**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and support .NET WPF/MAUI applications and services.
* Participate in technical reviews and recommend improvements, upgrades, and architecture changes.
* Research and evaluate software technologies and products.
* Implement best practices, standards, and procedures for quality and delivery.
* Ensure compliance with documented software processes throughout the product lifecycle.
* Collaborate with peer developers, Development Leads, and Product Managers to define functionalities and implementations.
* Work within an Agile team setup (6–9 members) and actively contribute to improvement initiatives.

**Key competencies to empower your journey. You’ll thrive in this role if you have:**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and in a team.
* Excellent communication skills in English.
* Excellent TEAM player.
* Excellent problem-solving skills.
* Enjoy working in a multi-cultural environment.

Skills

* Strong expertise in .NET Technologies: C#; .NET WPF; .NET Xamarin/MAUI; WCF Services; and Web API / REST, MVC
* Good understanding of concepts like authentication/authorization, client and server-side caching, multithreading, and performance optimization.
* HTML, JavaScript, Angular 12+ is a plus.
* Software Security Development principles.
* Strong understanding of OOP, design patterns, and enterprise architecture.
* Experience with TDD, unit and integration testing, and CI/CD pipelines.

Qualifications and education requirements

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science or related technical field.
* A senior-level software developer with strong and successful technical experience (7+ years of experience)
* Hands-on experience within agile software development methodologies in a multi-division processing company.
* Experience with Testing and CI; TDD, automated unit/functional/integration testing
* Strong understanding of Software Design Patterns and Enterprise Design Patterns, MS SQL Server skills or similar, especially in performance-related areas.
* Strong English language skills (oral and written)

**Location:**

* Be currently **located in Hungary**and**legally authorized to work in Hungary**.
* Be available to work in a hybrid model, attending our Vienna office two times per month.

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.*

jobs.title: Project Controls Engineer - Risk Management
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.  
Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives.

Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success. Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.  
Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

 **Job Description**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Risk Management Engineer or Project Controls Engineer with risk management experience to join our organization in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and mitigating project risks while maintaining robust project controls across multiple initiatives. You will work collaboratively with project teams, stakeholders, and senior management to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong organizational skills, technical proficiency, and the ability to communicate complex risk and control information effectively to diverse audiences.

* Acting as the Risk facilitator for a large aviation/ airport project.
* Implementing the Risk Management Plan and supporting project teams in applying the risk management process.
* Facilitating risk workshops with project stakeholders.
* Maintaining risk registers and ensuring risks and associated actions are updated accordingly.
* Preparing monthly and ad hoc risk reports.
* Undertaking ad hoc Quantitative Risk Assessments (QRAs), where required, outside of the formal Risk Management Plan and delivery governance framework.
* Maintaining a strong focus on risk mitigation plans and proactively following up with action owners to ensure timely completion of agreed actions.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 3 - 5+ years of experience in risk management, project controls, or related project management discipline
* Demonstrated expertise in risk identification, assessment, and mitigation planning
* Proficiency in project management software and tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or equivalent)
* Experience developing and maintaining risk registers and control documentation
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present findings to senior stakeholders
* Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar
* Ability to work effectively in a matrix environment and collaborate across multiple project teams
* Background in construction, engineering, or infrastructure project delivery or planning / project controls functions within a PMC/PMO environment is desired

  
**Additional Information**

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/

jobs.title: Medior Fullstack Software Engineer .NET
jobs.description:
Bij ENTER bouwen we complexe, schaalbare en innovatieve webapplicaties. Om onze software naar een hoger niveau te tillen, zoeken wij een Medior Fullstack Software Engineer .NET die zowel de frontend als de backend beheerst. Jij bent de pragmatische ontwikkelaar die niet alleen mooie architectuur bedenkt, maar ook gewoon doorpakt en kwalitatieve software oplevert.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Medior Fullstack Software Engineer .NET werk je aan de volledige stack van webapplicaties, van een goed doordachte backend in .NET tot een gebruiksvriendelijke frontend. Je denkt mee over de architectuur, maar verliest jezelf niet in eindeloos designen: je pakt door en levert. In een Agile/Scrum-team werk je samen met andere developers, product owners en UX-designers aan features die direct impact hebben op de eindgebruiker.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van applicaties, waarbij je oog hebt voor kwaliteit, leesbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid van de code. Je levert niet alleen werkende software op, maar ook software waar je trots op kunt zijn.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar afgerond.
Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring als (fullstack) .NET developer.
Je beheerst C# en het .NET-ecosysteem goed en weet dit toe te passen in productieomgevingen.
Je hebt praktische kennis van HTML, CSS en TypeScript voor het bouwen van moderne frontends.
Je hebt ervaring met minimaal één modern frontend framework, zoals Angular, React of Blazor.
Je snapt hoe je REST API's ontwerpt en implementeert, en hebt ervaring met Entity Framework of vergelijkbaar.
Je denkt pragmatisch: je zoekt de beste oplossing voor het probleem, niet de meest complexe.
Je hebt goede software design skills. Je kent de SOLID-principes, clean code en design patterns, en weet wanneer je ze wél en níet toepast.
Je bent de Nederlandse taal machtig in woord en geschrift.

Gewenste technische ervaring

Naast de kernvaardigheden hierboven werken we met een breed en modern toolinglandschap. Ervaring met (een deel van) onderstaande is een pré:
Backend & frameworks:
ASP.NET Core (Web API / MVC)
Entity Framework Core
Azure of een andere cloud-omgeving (AWS, GCP)

Frontend:

Angular, Vue of React
Blazor

Tooling & infrastructuur:

Git, Azure DevOps of GitHub Actions
Docker / containerisatie
SQL Server of een andere relationele database

Wie zijn wij?

ENTER is een technische detacheringsorganisatie die gespecialiseerd is in het verbinden van softwareprofessionals met uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland. Waar onze roots liggen in high-tech R&D en technische software, werken we steeds vaker aan grootschalige web- en cloudprojecten die een directe impact hebben op duizenden gebruikers. Denk aan moderne platformen, schaalbare webapplicaties en integraties met complexe architecturen.

Bij ENTER waarderen we vakmanschap en hechten we veel waarde aan de kwaliteit en onderhoudbaarheid van software. Voor ons betekent 'Tech with a heartbeat' dat we technologie met passie en toewijding benaderen, of dat nu in een high-tech of in een cloud-native omgeving is.

Onze professionals werken in vaste dienst en maken op projectbasis deel uit van de ontwikkelteams van onze klanten, meestal voor een periode van 1 tot 3 jaar. We matchen projecten zorgvuldig op basis van ervaring, ambities, persoonlijkheid en passie voor technologie. Tijdens het project word je begeleid door je manager vanuit ENTER, die je ondersteunt in je professionele groei met coaching en trainingen. Daarnaast bouwen we actief aan onze community. We organiseren regelmatig technisch inhoudelijke en sociale bijeenkomsten om kennisdeling en verbinding tussen collega’s te stimuleren. Bij ENTER combineren we technische expertise met een hechte cultuur. Sluit je aan bij ons team en werk mee aan innovatieve web-oplossingen bij aansprekende klanten!

#techwithaheartbeat

Wat bieden wij?

Een uitdagende rol in een moderne ontwikkelomgeving;
Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en certificeringen;
Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;
Regelmatige sociale activiteiten, zoals de jaarlijkse BBQ, het kerstdiner, een pubquiz en onze volledig verzorgde familiedag in de Efteling.
En nog veel meer!

Wil je meer weten?

Ben je nieuwsgierig geworden of heb je nog een paar vragen over de functie van Medior Fullstack Software Engineer .NET?

Neem dan contact op met Dieka van den Eijnde dieka.vandeneijnde@enter-group.nl

Ben je enthousiast en wil je direct solliciteren?

Klik dan op de solliciteerknop en laat je profiel achter. We nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

Door een profiel aan te maken en te solliciteren, ga je akkoord met onze privacyverklaring.
